name: refund
effect: *Refund is when you regain Strain. Increasing it by that amount. You cannot have more Strain then your Max Strain.*
short: Gain X Strain. You cannot have more Strain then your Max Strain.

name: break
effect:
A Break when you spend at least 30 minutes doing something you would find relaxing, such as reading, sleeping, exercise, meditation, etc. Again a Break must be a minimum of 30 minutes, after which you Refund all Strain (gain Max Strain) and refresh/end on Break effects.
- You can take up to 3 Breaks before you must Rest.
short: Spend 30 or more minutes of relaxation. Refund all Strain after.

name: rest
effect: A Rest is when you spend at least 8 hours doing something non-strenuous and/or relaxing, such as reading, sleeping, exercise, meditation, etc. Typically this is spent and the end of a day or after a main encounter. Again a Rest must be a minimum of 8 hours, after which you Heal to full (gain Max Health), Refund all Strain (gain Max Strain), loose all Death's Door you have, and refresh/end on Rest effects.
short: Spend 8 or more hours of relaxation. Heal to full, Refund all Strain, and lose all Death's Door after.

name: rough terrain
effect: You use 2 tiles worth of movement when moving onto a Rough Terrain tile.

name: death's door
effect:
- At 1 or more stacks of Death's Door you are permanently Slowed.
- At 2 stacks of Death's Door you become Unconscious until a creature heals you. Then you permanently have 4 Stun.
- At 3 stacks of Death's Door you die.

You lose all stacks of Death's Door at the end of a Rest.

name: bleeding out
effect: While you have 0 or less health. At the end of your turn roll a d12. If you roll a 6 or less you gain a stack of Death's Door. Another creature may do a BODY or MIND Check, aiming to get [7 + 2*Death's Door] or higher, to give you 1 health (removing Bleeding Out).

name: move
effect:
**Move** - Spend ⚂; Move your SPEED. If you need to climb something, do a Body check.  
_Jumping: When you do a move you may do a standing jump up 1+(BODY/2) or long-jump 2+BODY horizontally._
short:
Spend ⚂; Move your SPEED. If you need to climb something, do a Body check.  
_Jumping: When you do a move you may do a standing jump up 1+(BODY/2) or long-jump 2+BODY horizontally._

name: attack
effect:
**Attack** - Spend ⚂⚂; Do a Weapon Attack within the weapons range. If a dice sum of 7 or less is given, gain the Attack Bonus. If a dice sum of 9 or higher is given, gain the Attack Downside.  
_Dual Welding: You may dual wield weapons if both weapons are Side Weapons. When you do, you may combine the On Hit, Bonus, and Downside of both weapons into one Attack._
short:
Spend ⚂⚂; Do a Weapon Attack within the weapons range. If a dice sum of 7 or less is given, gain the Attack Bonus. If a dice sum of 9 or higher is given, gain the Attack Downside.  
_Dual Welding: You may dual wield weapons if both weapons are Side Weapons. When you do, you may combine the On Hit, Bonus, and Downside of both weapons into one Attack._

name: grapple
effect: **Grapple** - Spend ⚂⚂; Do a Body Contest against a target within 1 tile of you. If you win, the target becomes Grappled by you.
short: Spend ⚂⚂; Do a Body Contest against a target within 1 tile of you. If you win, the target becomes Grappled by you.

name: push
effect: **Push** - Spend ⚂⚂; Do a Body Contest against a target within 1 tile of you. If you win, the target is pushed back 1+BODY tiles away from you. (This counts as Knockback and can do Knockback damage.)
short: Spend ⚂⚂; Do a Body Contest against a target within 1 tile of you. If you win, the target is pushed back 1+BODY tiles away from you. (This counts as Knockback and can do Knockback damage.)

name: stealth
effect: **Stealth** - Spend ⚂⚂; Gain Cloaked if you are not seen.
short: Spend ⚂⚂; Gain Cloaked if you are not seen.

name: lock a dice
effect:
**Lock a Dice** - Spend ⚂; Lock the dice spent. You may only ever have 1 Locked dice at a time. Locking a dice while having a Locked dice will replace the old dice with the new dice. You may later unlock that dice to spend on Arts or as a bonus dice in combat.  
_You may only ever lock d6's, and lose any unspent locked dice at the end of combat._
short:
Spend ⚂; Lock the dice spent. You may only ever have 1 Locked dice at a time. Locking a dice while having a Locked dice will replace the old dice with the new dice. You may later unlock that dice to spend on Arts or as a bonus dice in combat.  
_You may only ever lock d6's, and lose any unspent locked dice at the end of combat._

name: activate an art
effect: **Activate an Art** - Spend dice, time, and or Strain to activate the art. Art's have recommended casting requirements (See Activating Art's in the Core Rules). Your GM may be open to changing these or requiring them.
short: Spend dice, time, and or Strain to activate the art. Art's have recommended casting requirements (See Activating Art's in the Core Rules). Your GM may be open to changing these or requiring them.

name: hunker down
effect: **Hunker Down** - Spend ⚂; Gain +1 Dodge against Ranged Attacks made against you until the beginning of your next turn.
short: Spend ⚂; Gain +1 Dodge against Ranged Attacks made against you until the beginning of your next turn.

name: overwatch
effect: **Overwatch** - Reaction (Locked ⚂); Melee Attack against a target that moves into/out of your Weapon Range. Use 3+⚂ for sum.
short: Reaction (Locked ⚂); Melee Attack against a target that moves into/out of your Weapon Range. Use 3+⚂ for sum.

name: use a non-attack item
effect: **Use a Non-Attack Item** - Spend ⚂; Use the item, such as drinking a potion, using a Bandage, or pulling a lever. Some items may cost more ⚂ to use depending on their complexity.
short: Spend ⚂; Use the item, such as drinking a potion, using a Bandage, or pulling a lever. Some items may cost more ⚂ to use depending on their complexity.
